children: Advasa adopted a dividend policy targeting a 50% annual cash payout ratio beginning with the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.
Board adopted a dividend policy targeting an annual cash payout ratio of 50% of net income attributable to common stockholders.
Payout ratio is based on consolidated net income under U.S. GAAP and excludes noncontrolling interests and preferred dividends.
Policy is a target only; any dividend declaration, amount and timing remain subject to Board approval and legal/contractual limits.
No dividend has been declared and no per-share amount, record date or payment date has been established.
